violations.excerpt: managed the enterprise data platform supporting AI-driven medication management for a company that serves 45+ health plans and over 30 million members — building HIPAA-compliant AI agents and observability tooling for an autonomous pharmacist AI system
violations.explanation: This sentence chains Arine's company-level metrics (45+ health plans, 30 million members) directly into Paul's personal work description (building AI agents and observability tooling) in a single long clause. While all facts are from Arine, the dash-connected construction could imply Paul's individual work touched all 45+ health plans and 30M members. The grounded source explicitly describes those as company-level metrics. This is borderline — the phrasing 'for a company that serves' does provide attribution — but the tight coupling is worth noting.

violations.excerpt: are all in my background today
violations.explanation: The closing phrase 'are all in my background today' is mildly superfluous — the entire letter has just demonstrated this. It approaches a 'precisely the kind of' or 'uniquely positioned' feel, though it is more restrained. Minor deduction.

violations.excerpt: I'd welcome a conversation about this role and am available at your convenience.
violations.explanation: This is a generic closing line that adds no information content. It is standard cover letter convention, but under strict Q1 it is a sentence that could be removed without reducing information content.

violations.excerpt: My healthcare AI work spans payors, clinical trials, genomics, and neuroimaging. Most recently at Arine, I managed the enterprise data platform... At Booz Allen Hamilton, I worked on AI products...
violations.explanation: The body paragraphs follow a mechanical pattern: topic sentence followed by 'At [Company], I did X. At [Company], I did Y.' repeated across paragraphs 2, 3, and 4. This parallel structure across multiple paragraphs creates a pattern-matching feel that could signal AI generation. Varying the paragraph structures more would help.
